requirements.Title: AI Productivity Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-powered productivity solutions for print, scan, and device management workflows to enhance SMB efficiency.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require automation and efficiency due to limited IT resources. AI solutions are a key differentiator.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatible hardware and software integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI-powered print, scan, and management features are available and functional in the product UI; user testing validates workflow improvements.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO (Total Cost of Ownership)
requirements.Description: Design the printer to deliver the lowest business TCO in HP's SMB portfolio, through efficient ink tank design and minimal maintenance requirements.
requirements.Rationale: Cost efficiency is a top SMB need and a competitive differentiator.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires efficient ink delivery system and durable components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Independent TCO analysis confirms Magellan's TCO is the lowest among HP SMB printers.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Implement a replaceable maintenance box that can be serviced directly by customers without requiring professional support.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs often lack dedicated IT support and require easy self-service features.
requirements.Dependencies: Design must ensure user safety and straightforward replacement process.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End-user documentation and testing demonstrate that the maintenance box can be replaced by non-IT staff within 5 minutes.

requirements.Title: SMB Device Management Portal
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated online portal for SMB customers to manage multiple printers, monitor usage, and access support resources.
requirements.Rationale: Unmanaged and lightly managed SMBs need easy, centralized control over their devices due to lack of IT staff.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires secure cloud infrastructure and integration with printer firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal allows registration, monitoring, and management of at least 6-15 printers per SMB; user acceptance tests show >90% satisfaction.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure that at least 60% of the printer's plastic content is made from recycled materials, exceeding major competitors.
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a key customer and regulatory requirement and a competitive differentiator.
requirements.Dependencies: Supply chain sourcing of recycled plastics; compliance with regulations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bill of materials and independent audit confirm 60% RCP in shipped units.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to prevent misfilling and ensure user-friendly, error-proof refilling.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents user error and reduces support incidents related to ink refilling.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink tank design must match bottle keying system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: User testing shows a 0% misfill rate during refills by non-IT staff.

requirements.Title: Warranty: 80k pages or 2 years (whichever first)
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty covering 80,000 pages printed or 2 years of use, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs value predictable costs and reliability guarantees.
requirements.Dependencies: Durability of printer components must meet warranty terms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty documentation and support systems are in place; field failure rates meet targets within warranty period.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: Customer Replaceable Parts and Service Center Thresholds
requirements.Description: Design printer so that most maintenance can be performed by customers (PHA), with only complex repairs requiring service center (MINK) intervention.
requirements.Rationale: Minimizes downtime and support costs for SMBs with limited IT resources.
requirements.Dependencies: Clear documentation and part design for easy replacement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: At least 80% of common maintenance tasks can be performed by end users as validated by usability studies.

requirements.Title: Support for SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB Portal (Non-PDL SKU)
requirements.Description: Ensure that Non-PDL SKUs support SMB2.0 Solutions and the Advanced View SMB portal.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with product segmentation and feature differentiation for SMB customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKUs pass integration tests with SMB2.0 Solutions and portal features.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Platform as a Service) Support
requirements.Description: Enable PaaS capabilities for remote device management, monitoring, and value-added services.
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP's strategic goal to accelerate PaaS adoption in SMB segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires cloud infrastructure and secure connectivity.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS features are available and functional for enrolled devices; security and compliance checks passed.

requirements.Title: PDL/PS Support and Print Speed Targets (PDL SKU)
requirements.Description: Provide PDL/PS support and achieve print speed targets of 25/20 ppm for PDL SKUs (improving from 25/19).
requirements.Rationale: Meets needs of higher-end SMB users and competitive benchmarks.
requirements.Dependencies: Hardware and firmware optimizations for speed and language support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKUs independently tested to achieve 25/20 ppm and full PDL/PS functionality.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification (PDL SKU)
requirements.Description: Ensure PDL SKUs are compliant with Blue Angel environmental standards.
requirements.Rationale: Environmental certifications are required in many markets and valued by customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Design and materials must meet Blue Angel criteria.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKUs achieve Blue Angel certification prior to launch.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing and HP App Integration
requirements.Description: Support mobile printing workflows and seamless integration with the HP App for SMB users.
requirements.Rationale: Mobile device usage is high among SMBs; simplifies printing and management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing tested with major OS; HP App integration validated with user acceptance tests.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features to monitor device health, usage, and enable proactive support.
requirements.Rationale: Telemetry enables predictive maintenance, reduces downtime, and supports PaaS.
requirements.Dependencies: Secure data collection and privacy compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is securely transmitted and actionable insights are available to HP and customers.

requirements.Title: Minimal Maintenance Design
requirements.Description: Engineer the printer for minimal maintenance, reducing the number of parts that require replacement over the device's lifetime.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs want reliable devices with low intervention and maintenance costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Field test data shows reduced maintenance events vs. comparable products.

requirements.Title: Launch Timeline: Spring 27 (1 Jun 27)
requirements.Description: Product must be ready for market launch by June 1, 2027.
requirements.Rationale: Meets business planning and market entry objectives.
requirements.Dependencies: All development and validation activities must be completed before launch date.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product available for sale and shipping by 1 Jun 27.
